dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: A prominent convex deviation on the right lateral margin corresponding to the pectoral limb; the opposing left margin exhibits a continuous, smooth edge.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-tone gray baseline across the visible dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A faint, curvilinear mark of lighter pixel intensity located posterior to the blowhole on the right side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct curved scar or mark visible in the cranial-dorsal region behind the blowhole.
